description: Create a folder — in a project's Test Cases tree (default) or Test Runs tree (pass project_id), or in the organization-level Modules tree (no project_id needed; module folders are shared across projects). Optionally nest it under an existing parent folder to build folder trees. Deleting folders is not available through this connection.

parent_folder_id.description: Nest under this existing folder (ULID); omit for top level

project_id.description: Project ID (ULID) — required for the test-cases and test-runs trees; not used for modules

tree.description: Which folder tree to create in (default test-cases). "modules" is organization-level.

name: tm_create_folder
title: Create Folder
